period.rule: A document belongs to the period iff its LOCAL calendar date (timestamp converted to manifest.timezone) is within [period_start, period_end] inclusive. Timestamps may be written with any offset (e.g. +00:00); always convert first.
period.opening_balances: Invoices issued before the period appear as 1200/3000 opening rows dated period_start.

fx.rate_meaning: fx.csv rate = units of target_currency per 1 unit of source_currency
fx.rate_date: local calendar date of the document (issued_at for invoices, timestamp for payments)
fx.ar_clearing_rate: receipts credit 1200 at the rate of the INVOICE date (historical rate); the difference to cash goes to 7000 FX gain/loss

accounts.2900 Suspense - unapplied cash: receipts not applied to an invoice

posting_rules: invoice: Dr 1200 / Cr 4000 at invoice-date rate, timestamp = issued_at (local)
receipt: Dr 1000 (amount at payment-date rate); Cr 1200 per invoice_ref at invoice-date rate; excess over refs -> Cr 2100; amount not applied -> Cr 2900; balancing -> 7000
receipt with empty invoice_refs (unidentified payer) -> Cr 2900 (legitimate)
split payments, multi-invoice payments, partial payments and recurring identical amounts are legitimate
documents dated in the next period must not be posted

duplicate_invoice.meaning: The same invoice (same entity, currency, local issue date and identical line_items) is posted twice.

missing_or_partial_allocation.meaning: A payment's invoice_refs allocate an amount to an invoice, but the ledger credits less (or nothing) to 1200 for that payment+invoice; the rest sits in 2900 suspense.
missing_or_partial_allocation.amount: unapplied part, in payment currency minor units
missing_or_partial_allocation.tolerance_minor: conversion resolution: ceil(10^(exp_src-exp_base)/rate)+1 (0 for base currency)

fx_conversion_error.meaning: A foreign-currency document is posted with a rate other than the policy rate.
fx_conversion_error.amount: |booked base amount - correct base amount| of the 1200 debit (invoice) or 1000 debit (payment)

period_cutoff_error.meaning: A document whose local date is outside the period is posted in this period.

evidence.ids: doc_id (invoice_id/payment_id also accepted), ledger row_id, fx_id
evidence.rule: a finding is supported if its evidence_ids contain at least one complete accepted evidence set

typical_sets.duplicate_invoice: both invoice docs + a ledger row (1200 or 4000) of the duplicate
typical_sets.missing_or_partial_allocation: payment doc + its 2900 suspense row; if partly applied, also the invoice doc and the 1200 credit row of that payment+invoice
typical_sets.fx_conversion_error: document + its 1200/4000 row (invoice) or 1000 row (payment) + fx_id of the correct date

submission.schema: {episode_id, findings:[{type, affected_ids, claimed_amount_minor, currency, evidence_ids, explanation}]}
